# China's Open-Source Technology: Landscape and History (Nov 2026)

External report, published here with the author's permission (Ian, 24 Nov 2026, via Fabio Pietrosanti). Rights remain with the author. Our analysis: [docs/EXT-REPORT-CN-OSS-LANDSCAPE.md](../../../docs/EXT-REPORT-CN-OSS-LANDSCAPE.md).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `china-open-source-landscape-2026-11.pdf` | The report as received. 149 pages. SHA-256 `36f38fd9061cf39892a32c341022cf5e8853a6eb662c371e300a205dfc6d86ad` |
| `projects.tsv` / `projects.json` | 504 projects parsed from the report's tables: area, name, kind (OSS / Commercial / Upstream / Standard), organisation, since, governance stage, stars, vitality index, URL, description, page. `in_repo` = already mentioned in this repo on 24 Nov 2026 |
| `sources.tsv` | 741 unique links cited in the report, with page, anchor text and whether this repo already cited them |

The tables were extracted by us from the PDF's text layout, so parsing errors are ours, not the author's. Repository metrics (stars, vitality) are the author's, collected 2026-11-22 (GitHub only).
